reviewed_effect_properties: Every relay cgroup.kill write and pidfd_send_signal runs through Session::Perform, with a fresh window check both before and after scope/transport I/O.
Guarded reaper path is synchronous and never queues a delayed kill; failed group write requires a fresh independent gate before held-pidfd fallback.
cgroup.procs numeric PID enumeration is refused in relay mode.
Group traversal is beneath the pinned accounting root with openat2 NO_SYMLINKS and NO_XDEV; held cgroup.kill inode must match exact uid/pid subtree.
Watchdog duplicates held pidfd and group fd while record lock is held; the shared session check uses try-lock.
Relay HUP/ERR/control data preempts pressure records from the same event batch; it is not sent to ctrl_data_close as a framework socket index.
Required relay initialization does not fall back to direct PSI.

confirmed_open_integration.native_behavior: cell_relay_stop stops monitoring, revokes the one-generation session, and does not itself exit or restart. Re-enrollment in the same process is rejected.
confirmed_open_integration.recovery_dependency: Production lifecycle caller must wait for actual admission and PSI-worker retirement receipt, then stop and recreate the exact owned cell/LMKD. inventory reports host-next adapter is being implemented and this production caller is not yet wired.
confirmed_open_integration.implication: Loss of lease can leave this LMKD process without pressure effects until an external lifecycle restart. This is safe revocation but not demonstrated production recovery.
confirmed_open_integration.separate_existing_path: LMK_UPDATE_PROPS reinitialization failure already exits(1) for supervisor restart; do not confuse that branch with relay HUP handling.
